messages:
Maya Chen: Quick thread — we need final copy and assets for the benchmark + webinar push next Tuesday. Plan: LinkedIn long post, X thread (3 tweets + CTA), and one short video clip for stories. :rocket:

Jorge Alvarez: Sounds good. Which benchmark angle are we leaning into — latency/cost or reliability? need the headline to set tone.

Maya Chen: leaning latency + cost wins (real numbers from the eval run). headline draft: "40% lower per-token cost at p99 latencies you can rely on" — open to tightening. @Priya can you draft a 2-line hook for LI and a 3-tweet sequence? :eyes:

Priya Patel: putting a draft in the doc now. For the X thread: 1) stat + hook, 2) quick explainer + example prompt, 3) CTA to webinar + link. CTA copy options: "Join our webinar: serving that scales" or "See the numbers live — sign up." Which is stronger?

Jorge Alvarez: second feels generic. how about: "See how we cut per-token cost 40% without sacrificing p99 — webinar signup" — clearer.

Alex Nguyen: Asset ask — I'll need the benchmark chart (png/pdf), a 9:16 clip (15s) of the demo, and a static hero (1200x627) for LI. Can the eng team export the CSV by EOD so I can generate charts? Also please share brand-safe color for text overlays.

Maya Chen: @eng-oncall exported results earlier — link in drive: https://drive.google.com/benchmark-2026-march (internal). CSV + raw logs there. Team, please pull the chart named "latency_cost_summary.png".

Sam O'Neill: Paid amplification — recommend boosting the LI post to dev platform audiences and a small X promote for the top tweet. Budget ask: $800 total. Approving if we can target dev tools + ML infra.

Priya Patel: Draft copy pasted below for review:

Tweet 1: "Benchmarked: same model, smarter serving. 40% lower per-token cost at p99 latencies that meet production SLAs."
Tweet 2: "How? batching, KV caching, and quantization profiles tailored to workload. We share configs + tradeoffs in the webinar."
Tweet 3: "Want the full runbook + live demo? Join our webinar on Mar 24 — sign up: tiny.cc/redwood-web21"

Maya Chen: copy looks strong. Small edits: change "Meet production SLAs" -> "meet your SLOs". Also add hashtags: #mlinfra #inference #devtools

Alex Nguyen: I uploaded the hero and a 15s clip to the drive: /assets/social/launch_15s.mp4 and hero_launch_1200x627.png. Use caption-safe text only in top 20% for stories.

SchedulerBot: Calendar invite created: Webinar — "Serving at Scale: Cost & Latency Tradeoffs" on 2026-03-24 11:00 AM PT. Registration page: https://redwood.com/webinar/register/21.

Jorge Alvarez: Workflow checklist for publishing (assignments):
- Maya: final LI post + X thread copy (this thread)
- Priya: thread + captions for clip (incl. alt text)
- Alex: upload final hero + clip + sizes done
- Sam: set up paid boosts after live post
- Ops: confirm embed link on registration page

Maya Chen: I'll push final copy by 5pm PT. If anyone has major edits ping me here. Otherwise we'll schedule posts for 11:05 AM PT on the 24th to align with webinar start. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: minor tweak — change CTA link to the UTM tagged version: https://redwood.com/webinar/register/21?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch

Maya Chen: noted, will use UTM. Thanks all!

Sam O'Neill: tagging @Jorge to coordinate creative boost audience once posts go live.

Jorge Alvarez: on it. I'll post the X thread, then queue the LI post in Sprout with the hero. Will monitor replies for first hour and flag top questions to the product team for follow-up. :mag:

Alex Nguyen: one last ask — can we get a two-line quote from Alex (PM) or Maya (PM) for the LI post? short, punchy.

Maya Chen: I'll grab a quote from Lina (PM) and paste here by EOD.
